meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: Claude 会扮演短篇网文市场分析师，抓取知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台榜单，产出扫榜报告：情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警和值得写的方向。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-short-scan 或 /短篇扫榜，或问「短篇什么火」等话题时触发；之后它会先问你平台和方向。

say.text: 帮我看下七猫短篇最近什么火
say.note: 先确认平台与方向，再采集数据出报告

say.text: 扫一下知乎盐言的榜单，抓风口题材
say.note: 输出情绪排行、题材热点与风口预警

say.text: 把知乎和点众的短篇热门题材做对比
say.note: 走平台对比分析，给可写方向

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a short-story web-fiction market analyst: it scrapes platform charts (Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, Dianzhong) and outputs a scan report with emotion rankings, topic hotspots, trend alerts and writable directions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you enter /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜, or ask things like “what's hot in short fiction”; it then asks which platform and direction you want.

say_en.text: Check what's hot in Qimao short stories right now
say_en.note: It confirms platform and direction first

say_en.text: Scan the Zhihu Yanyan charts and find trending topics
say_en.note: Returns emotion rankings and trend alerts

say_en.text: Compare hot topics on Zhihu and Dianzhong
